config.imageDefaultDir.description: Folder for saving images. Leave blank to save them in the same folder as the Markdown file. Enter an absolute path (such as /path/to/dir) or a path relative to the Markdown file's folder (such as ./images).
config.forceRelativeImagePath.descriptio: Always use relative paths for images in Markdown, even if the image folder is set to an absolute path.
config.language.description: Choose the editor language, or select 'default' to match VS Code. Settings descriptions always use VS Code's display language.
config.toolbarMode.description: Choose which buttons appear in the toolbar.
config.toolbarMode.simple: Show only undo, redo, and view controls. Press Cmd+/ (macOS) or Ctrl+/ (Windows/Linux) to access other editing actions.
config.outlineStateScope.description: Choose how to remember whether the outline is open or closed.
config.outlineStateScope.file: Remember whether the outline is open or closed for each Markdown file in the current workspace.
config.outlineStateScope.global: Reuse the outline's last open or closed state for all Markdown files, across all workspaces.
config.outlineDefaultOpen.description: Open the outline by default if no previous choice has been saved.
config.outlineActiveColor.description: Choose the color used to highlight the section currently being read in the outline.
config.outlineActiveColor.theme: Use the current theme's accent color.
config.enableDebugLogging.description: Record debug logs to help troubleshoot editor problems.
config.export.pdfWhiteBackground.descrip: Export PDFs with a white page and the GitHub light appearance for readable text and diagrams. Disable to use the current editor theme across the whole page, including margins. Other export formats are unaffected.
config.export.pandocPath.description: Path to the Pandoc executable for DOCX and EPUB export. Leave blank to detect an installed tool. Installation is user-managed; an invalid explicit path is reported without falling back.
config.export.browserPath.description: Path to a Chrome, Chromium or Edge executable for headless PDF export. Leave blank to detect an installed browser. No browser is downloaded automatically.
config.export.showCodeLanguage.descripti: Show the declared code language in an italic, boxed label below each code block in DOCX and PDF exports. Turning this off keeps code block formatting.
command.exportToHtml.title: Export to HTML
command.exportToPdf.title: Export to PDF
command.exportToDocx.title: Export to Word
command.exportToEpub.title: Export to EPUB
command.copyBuildInformation.title: Copy Build Information
config.math.backslashDelimiters.descript: Recognize backslash equation delimiters \( ... \) and \[ ... \] in the editor and exports. Disable to treat them as ordinary Markdown escapes.
config.tableToolbarPosition.description: Choose where table controls appear. Automatic avoids occupied space and uses the top bar when needed. Fixed positions remain selected and scroll when space is limited.
